resources.string: Hold a letter on the phone\'s keys to type the symbol printed on it, or to run an action you picked.

This service does two jobs. Hold Symbols: while you\'re in a text box, a held letter types the symbol printed on it, and a quick press types the letter. It steps aside while TitanKeys is your keyboard. Keys for actions: while no text box is open, holding a letter from A to Z runs the action you picked for it. For both, Titan Tools holds each plain letter press for a moment and sends it again through Android with Shizuku, so a quick press still types or does what it always did. Without Shizuku, the first press of a held letter still goes through. Keys with Shift, Alt or another modifier and password fields are left alone. It also notes that a key went down, never which key, for the keyboard light\'s log. It reads no text, looks at nothing on the screen, and stores or sends nothing.
